description: This file defines the OrderByList class, which manages a list of ordering criteria for querying entities, including methods for adding, checking, and generating SQL order by clauses, as well as comparison logic for entities based on the specified order.

classes.name: OrderByList
classes.description: A class that maintains a list of order-by items for entity query sorting, providing methods to add criteria, validate against a model, generate SQL snippets, and compare entities.

methods.name: addOrderBy
methods.description: Overloaded methods to add order-by criteria from strings, collections, or OrderByItem objects, with options for descending order.

methods.name: checkOrderBy
methods.description: Validates each order-by item against a given model entity, throwing an exception if invalid.

methods.name: makeOrderByString
methods.description: Generates an SQL ORDER BY clause string based on the list of criteria.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two entities based on the order-by criteria.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code for the order-by list.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another OrderByList object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the order-by clause.
